qa_method: Original-resolution view_image inspection of both final workspace PNG files; no browser automation.

checks.check: all individual paper collars, labels and sleeves removed
checks.observation: Both unit cups have uninterrupted transparent walls with no paper component or opaque backing.

checks.check: one open and one sealed clear cup preserved
checks.observation: Foreground cup remains open; rear cup retains a flat full-perimeter foil and asymmetric tab.

checks.check: direct black copy exact and minimal
checks.observation: Both cups visibly read MORA and THYME HONEY in black, with no surrounding panel, color marker or extra package copy.
Dense ivory yogurt, amber honey ribbon, thyme flecks, spoonful and thyme sprig remain coherent.
Left half remains a continuous low-detail gray field without product, prop, strong cast shadow or high-contrast edge.
Wall thickness, rim highlights, food-wall contact, foil contact and upper-left single-source shadows are visually plausible.

known_limits: Direct print is a generated visual, not evidence of ink registration, adhesion, migration or condensation-rub performance.
Transparent packaging is not evidence of validated light or barrier performance.

checks.observation: The frame contains one food-filled transparent cup, one separate foil, one spoon and one outer two-cup carrier.
No collar ring, panel, window, seam, lock tab, sleeve fragment or collar shadow remains.

checks.check: direct black print on clear cup
checks.observation: MORA and THYME HONEY appear directly on the clear wall with food visible behind and no backing.
Clear polymer, flat foil, metal spoon and molded fiber are spatially separated with air and distinct surface responses.
Right-side pulp component has two wells and does not touch or wrap the individual cup.
Object scale, contact shadows, foil thickness, clear rim and carrier pulp relief align under one upper-left light.

known_limits: The anatomy image demonstrates conceptual separation only; it does not prove dimensional fit, seal, drop, cold-chain or sorting performance.
The molded-fiber carrier does not imply recyclable, certified, insulating or sustainable performance.

release_boundary: Suitable as Stage 2 directional image assets after canonical and registry owners perform their own merge and validation. Not suitable as manufacturing, regulatory or environmental evidence.
